poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE WEIGHT OF ALL UNTOLD DESIRE HANGS IN THE AIR
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A PROMISE CHASED ACROSS GOLD-FILLED HOURGLASSES
poetryFrame.bottomLine: LET THE DAWN WASH AWAY WHAT WAS LOST TONIGHT
sonnetLines: The hour breaks with gilded light,
A silent promise in the pane.
We shed the shadows of the night,
And wash away the former pain.
You are the vintage, rich and deep,
The careful craft of passing time.
I give my breath to your command,
A yielding grace, a steady tide.
With open palm and willing hand,
There is no place left now to hide.
Just this bright dawn, worth every cost,
